name: Family Accounting Tool
description_en: Web-based finance management tool for partners with partially shared expenses. `Apache-2.0` `Scala`
readme_preview:
Family Accounting Tool ====================== Family Accounting Tool keeps track of every transaction your family makes. Its goal is to: - Extract useful statistics from the data
_E.g.: How much is spent on food each month?_ - Calculate internal debt
_E.g.: Alice buys toilet paper for the whole family with her own money. This tool then registers that the family owes Alice the cost of the toilet paper._ - Provide a way to check if no money is disappearing in unexpected expenses
